title: Approval prompt reduction requires client permissions or supported Codex settings
summary: The owner requested fewer repeated Allow clicks. Official Codex approval documentation describes non-interactive approval policy and automatic approval review as settings. Never approval policy suppresses prompts but retains the selected sandbox restrictions; it does not automatically grant blocked actions. The current managed workspace exposes its project .codex directory as read-only, and no available tool changes the active chat permission mode. No approval setting or hook was changed. The documentation fetch required an escalated command after sandbox DNS resolution failed.
nextSteps: Select the desired approval mode in the client permissions UI; managed policy may limit available modes.
